scope: Provisional exact-source V2-8H implementation/test review before complete validation; historical decision for the cancellation-resurrection defect.

findings.title: Persist caller cancellation before preparation can recover
findings.detail: The aborted-signal publication guard rolls back the transaction that marks the turn cancelled. A pre-dispatch abort leaves preparing, lease expiry restores submitted, and a new worker can call the provider for that aborted turn.

independentReproduction.backend: transactional in-memory fixture, no database or service
